character.prompt: Create ONE photorealistic canonical character-reference portrait, vertical 9:16. A newly invented adult Vietnamese woman, about 28 years old, oval face, natural dark-brown eyes, straight small nose, naturally shaped lips, warm medium-light skin with realistic slight texture, dark hair neatly tied in a LOW PONYTAIL, a few tidy small wisps by ears. Plain cream long-sleeve cotton blouse with a simple collar, no jewelry. Medium head-and-upper-torso view, facing camera, both ears and full hairline visible, shoulders level, relaxed closed-mouth friendly half-smile. Neutral pale warm-gray studio backdrop. Stable bright softbox illumination from front-left plus gentle fill, neutral white balance, no harsh shadows or backlight. This is a fictional adult, not a likeness of any real person. Exact face, hairstyle and blouse will be used as an identity anchor across later product-review scenes. No product, other person, text, collage, graphic, label, signature or watermark. One single portrait, not a contact sheet.

clips.dialogue:
[surprised] Nhìn như hộp phấn, hóa ra sạc dự phòng! [playful] Tím pastel, bo góc xinh ghê, mấy ní!

[upbeat] Vỏ trơn, quai đồng màu, có ô báo mức pin. [explaining] Liếc nhanh để chủ động chuẩn bị trước khi ra ngoài.
